data.name: Fahemun
data.gender_notes: Fahemun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'fahama' which means 'to understand, comprehend'. Fahemun signifies one who has a deep understanding and knowledge of the world and its complexities. The name Fahemun carries the meaning “Understanding, Knowledge” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fahemun usually hope their child will grow to embody understanding, knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the pursuit of knowledge and understanding in the spiritual realm, reflecting the belief in continuous learning and growth.
data.etymology: Fahemun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Understanding, Knowledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fahemun total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: فهمون
in_arabic.meaning: فهمون نام کا مطلب ہے سمجھدار، عقلمند، اور دانا
in_arabic.long_meaning: فهمون نام کا مطلب ہے سمجھدار، عقلمند، اور دانا۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے، جہاں اس کا اصل معنی ہے 'سمجھنا' یا 'عقل رکھنا'۔ قرآن میں بھی اس جیسے الفاظ ملتے ہیں جو عقل اور سمجھ کے معانی رکھتے ہیں۔ فهمون نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے اور علم و حکمت کی علامت ہے۔

in_urdu.name: فہمون
in_urdu.meaning: فہمون کا مطلب ہے سمجھدار اور عقلمند
in_urdu.long_meaning: فہمون نام عربی زبان کے الفاظ سے بنا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے سمجھدار، دانا، اور عقلمند۔ اردو میں اس نام کو اہل علم اور فہم کے طور پر سمجھا جاتا ہے۔ اسلامی روایات میں بھی اس جیسے ناموں کا ذکر ملتا ہے جو علم اور حکمت کی اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: फहेमुन
in_hindi.meaning: फहेमुन का अर्थ है समझदार और बुद्धिमान
in_hindi.long_meaning: फहेमुन नाम का अर्थ है समझदार, बुद्धिमान और ज्ञानी। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका मूल अर्थ है 'समझना' या 'बुद्धि रखना'। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी इस नाम का महत्व है जो ज्ञान और बुद्धि की प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: فهیمون
in_pashto.meaning: فهیمون د معنا ده پوهیدونکی او هوښیار
in_pashto.long_meaning: فهیمون نوم د پوهیدونکی، هوښیار او دانا مطلب لري. دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چیرته چې د هغې اصلي معنی 'پوهیدل' یا 'عقل درلودل' دي. د افغان او پښتون دودیزو کې دا نوم د پوهې او حکمت د نښه په توګه کارول کېږي.

in_english.name: Fahemun
in_english.meaning: Fahemun means intelligent, understanding, and wise
in_english.long_meaning: Fahemun is derived from Arabic roots, signifying one who is intelligent, understanding, and wise. The name relates to Quranic themes of knowledge and cognition. Historically, it symbolizes wisdom and intellectual capability, cherished in Islamic tradition. Fahemun remains a meaningful choice, reflecting positive attributes of insight and perception.

data.cultural_impact: Fahemun is a name that carries the rich cultural heritage of the Islamic world, imbued with the traditional Islamic values of knowledge, wisdom and understanding. It is a name that signifies intelligence, insight and a deep appreciation for intellectual pursuits. In many Islamic cultures, learning and education are highly valued, and the name Fahemun would be considered an honor for someone who embodies these qualities.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Fahemun represents the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom as a means to draw closer to God. In Islamic tradition, education is seen as an essential component of faith, and the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is recorded to have said, "Seeking knowledge is obligatory upon every Muslim." Fahemun, then, is not just a name that denotes intellectual ability, but also a reminder of the importance of seeking knowledge and understanding as a way to deepen one's connection to the divine.
